title: Is it possible to offer specific skills—such as gardening, maintenance, or cooking—toward my seva?

segments.text: Every contribution, big or small, plays a vital role in supporting our community: ​All Skills Welcome: Whatever your unique talents or abilities—whether technical, creative, organizational, or practical—they are warmly welcomed. ​Service Over Skill: More than any specific talent, it is your spirit of service (bhava) and willingness to contribute that truly matters. ​Serve in Your Own Way: If you feel drawn to serve in a specific area or offer a particular skill, you are fully encouraged to do so. Simply inform a volunteer or mentor, and we will help align your service with what you enjoy doing most.
